tei:div.tei:p: "$ (1)༄༅// rdo rje'i rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa'i rgyud dang man ngag gi snying po'i gzhung

bzhugs so/// / (2)༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ shrī kā la tsakra garbha nā ma tant+ra/ bod skad du/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi snying po/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo// thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes sku// nyin mor byed pa'i 'od lta bu// padma'i 'dab ma 'dra ba'i spyan// sangs rgyas seng ge'i gdan la bzhugs// lha yi mchog gis phyag byas par// spyi bos gtugs te phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal po zla ba bzang pos zhus// yan lag padma sbyar ba ni// yan lag ma2chog la bzhag byas te// dus kyi 'khor lo'i sbyor ba ni// rtsod pa dag gi dus kyi ni// mi rnams grol ba'i rgyu ru'o/ ༈ /so sor sdud pa rnam pa bcu// rgyal ba yi ni dbang por 'gyur// de bzhin bsam gtan mi skyod pa// srog dang rtsol ba ral gri can// slar la yang ni rnam pa bcu// gzung ba rin chen phyag rgya can// g.yung mo rjes su dran pa ni// padma 'dzin pa ru ni 'gyur// dpal gyi ting 'dzin 'khor lo can// re re yang ni lnga ru dbye// slar la yang ni gang dbye ba// a la sogs dang ka la sogs/ ༈ /so sor sdud pa yul dang ni// yul can rnam pa bcu po rnams// lus la 'jug pa med pa'o// shes rab rtog dang dpyod pa'o// dga' ba mi g.yo bde ba dang*// bsam gtan sems ni rtse gcig pa'o// srog dang rtsol ba gnyis kyi lam// mi 'khrug pa ru 'gyur ba ni// dbu mar srog ni 'jug pa'o// thig le ru ni srog (3)'jug cing*// gnyis ka 'gro dang 'ong ba dag /gzung ba yid ni sems gcig pa// gtum mo yi ni snang ba gang*// lus la nges par gsal 'gyur ba// nam mkha' de ni rjes dran 'gyur// shes rab thabs kyi bdag nyid kyi// lhan cig skyes pa'i bden dbang gis// ye shes sku ni ting 'dzin te// 'di ni chu sogs dbye ba yis// gsum du yang ni 'gyur ba yin// sna tshogs bdag po'i sgrub thabs so// phyag rgya gsum dang tshad ni gsum// rnam pa gsum gyi srid dbang gis// las dang kun rtog bzang po yi/

༈ /so sor sdud pa rnal 'byor pa// yul du rnam par bral ba dang*// sngags kun gyis ni byin gyis brlab// bsam gtan sbyor ba dag pa yis// mngon shes lnga ni thob par 'gyur// srog dang rtsol ba dag pas ni// zla ba dri ma dag pas bral// byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis mchod// gzung ba yi ni stobs kyis ni// nyon mongs la sogs bdud 'joms shing*// stobs bcu la ni 'jug par 'gyur// dri med 'od 'phro dkyil 'khor te// gzhan spang ye shes sku las so// de phyir dag pa ting 'dzin gyis// nyi ma cung zad tsam gyis ni// ye shes sku ni 'grub par 'gyur/ ༈ /so sor sdud la sogs pa yis// gal te gzir bar de 'gyur na// sngags pa rnams kyis 'dod mi 'grub// sgra la goms pa yan lag ma'i// pad sogs rdo rje nor bu yi// thig le bsgrub pa song bar bya// bsnyen pa dang po sbyor ba ni// (4)nam mkha' ru ni rnam pa bcu// 'khor lo can ni khro lta ba'o// bgegs ni mthar byed kyi lta ba// bdud rtsi lam du song ba yang*// nye ba'i bsnyen pa yan lag drug /shes rab las 'phros zla thig le// gzhan yang rdo rje nor bu ste// yi ge gsum ni sgrub par 'gyur// bde ba ma nyams gcig zhi ba// lhan cig skyes pa ru ni 'gyur// sgrub chen ye shes sbyor ba'o/ ༈ /srog dang rtsol ba kun nas ni// mgo bo'i bar ni phan pa ste// mnyam pa'i bde ba 'bras ster ba// de las steng ni mi phan pa// 'chi ba'i 'jig pa byed pa'o// sems can nges par klog pa'i rgyu// gtsug tor sgo ni phug nas su// mchog tu bde ba'i go 'phang du// 'di ni sbyar ba bya ba nyid// phung po med pa'i rnal 'byor ma// mnyam pa'i bde ba la bzhugs mod// 'on kyang 'jig rten grags pa med/ ༈ /dbus su srog dang 'jug pa ni// yul dang rnam par bral ba nyid// sna tshogs yum gyis 'khyud pa'o// padmar 'jug pa'i rang rdo rje// spro ba yang ni de bzhin te// rdo rje dbus su gzhag par bya// sa bon ma lhung ba bde ba// shin chu chags pa'i chags par song*// rnal 'byor pa yi 'byor pa nyid// mchog tu yang ni khyab pa'i bdag

/dpal ni gsang la gsang ba po// gtsug tor du ni rtse lnga pa'o// rdo rje yi ni 'gyur ba yin// phyi yi rtse mo nyis 'gyur du// 'gyur ba chos kyi dkyil 'khor ro// de ni gnyis su 'dres pa dang*// de ni gzhan yang nyis 'gyur ro// de yi yang ni gzhan nyis 'gyur// lhan cig skyes dang longs spyod rdzogs// sprul pa yi ni 'khor lor ro// de yi nang du rtse gcig go /mnyam pa'i bde ba'i 'bras ster ba// gsang ba'i padma'i nang gsang ba'o// rnal 'byor pa dang srog gcod pa// nyin dang mtshan du phye ba ni// de ni srog 'jigs pa ru gsungs// sgra gang kha dang bral ba ni// snying la yod par rab 'gyur pa// de ni brdzun du smra ba nyid// kun mkhyen gyi ni ye shes par// (5)'dzin par yang ni dbye ba gang*// rnal 'byor pa la de gsungs so// bde ba'i thig le ma lhung ba// gzhan gyi bud med du ni 'gyur// bden pa chags bral min pa'o// srog dang rtsol ba'i me yis ni// ri bong can la zhu ba yi// btung ba chang gi btung ba'o// mthe bo'i tshigs nas gtsug tor du// chos kyi dbang gis 'gro ba ni// nya mthar thug pa rang gi sems// gtsug tor gnas nas mthe bo ru// yang ni 'dir ni 'gro 'gyur te// nag po'i phyogs kyi mthar thug par// rnal 'byor ma spyod pa des ni// nyi ma re re'i dus su ni// 'dod pa'i dngos grub rab tu ster/ ༈ /spyod dang 'dod pas lus tsha na// mchog gi kha yi padma las// tshig mi 'byung dang gnyid log dang*// 'gul dang na ba lkugs pa dang*// yid ni 'khrugs dang brgyal ba ni// du ba la sogs rdo rje can// de rnams gsal ba rnam pa bcu// srog can lus kyi gnas skabs so// 'jig rten 'dod pa'i gnas skabs ni// nges pa kho na gsal ba las// su zhig rgyal ba su 'dod pa// thig le dkar po'i rgyun ni gang*// nyin dang mtshan mor ltung ba ni// ma mā kī ni de chad do// go ku la sogs mig la sogs// nyi ma re re bzhin spro bas// sha gzhan re 'ga' yang ma yin// bdud rtsi lnga rnams brtan pa ni// rang gi rigs kyi sar song ba// lha rnams dge ba'i lus las so// stong pa'i sems de rtsod pa yis// lhan cig skyes pa khyab bde bas// de ni skye gnas 'khrig pa med/

༈ /nor gyi sbyin pa btang ba dang*// bud med sbyor la yid kyis ni// mi 'dzag pa ni tshul khrims so// bzod pa sgra sogs mi 'jug pa// gnyi gar 'gro ba'i le lo ni// rnam par 'jig pa brtson 'grus so// bsam gtan shes rab sems dang ni// bde ba lhan cig par song ba// kun 'gro thams cad brjod pa'o// sems can don du de rdzu 'phrul// srid pa don ni med byed pa// thob pa gzhan ni bzhi pa'o/ ༈ /lus gcig la ni nus (6)ldan pa// cha dgu dang ni lhan cig pa// nyi shu rtsa lnga bdag nyid sogs// bsam gtan phyag rgya'i gnyis dag nyid// cung zad tsam gyi nyi ma yis// dngos grub yang dag 'byung bar 'gyur// zhi ba dbang dang rengs pa dang*// srid pa 'jigs par byed pa ni// zhal gyi dbyibs phye ba nyid// 'byung ba rnams kyi dkyil 'khor gnas// lha min lag 'gro dag gi rigs// 'di bsgoms nas ni bsgrub par bya// dpal dam pa dang po'i sangs rgyas stong phrag bcu gnyis pa las gsungs pa dpal dus kyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba las thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa/ sbyor ba yan lag drug gi sgrubs thabs bkol ba'i dum bu'o// rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrī bha dra bo dhi'i zhal snga nas dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba gyi jo bandhe zla ba'i 'od zer gyis 'bro dge slong gi phyir bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'di dpal dus kyi 'khor lo rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i sgrub thabs zur du bkol ba sbyor drug gi rgyud chung zhes grags pa rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi man ngag gi rtsa bar gyur pa ste/ snga rab rnams kyis bsdus don mchan bu sogs mang du snang zhing*/ bsdus don gyi snying po'o// gleng 1gzhi dang ni sbyor drug gi// rigs 2bdag brkyang 3thabs 'bras bu 4dang*// yan5 lag bzhi dang 'pho ba dang 6// chags 7can lam dang gegs sel ba8// gnas 9skabs mthar thug 10'bras bu'o// zhes so/

༈ /rgya gar skad du/ ṣoḍaṅga yo ga u pa de sha nā ma/ bod skad du/ sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i man ngag ces bya ba// dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo// sbyor ba yan lag drug gi man ngag dus zhabs snyan brgyud du grags pa'i rdo rje'i tshig rkang 'di la gsum/ klad dang*// gzhung dang*/ mjug go /dang po la gnyis/ mchod par brjod pa dang*/ brtsam par dam bca' ba'o// dang po ni/ dus kyi 'khor lor phyag 'tshal nas/ gnyis pa ni/ rnal 'byor yan lag drug bshad bya// gnyis pa gzhung gi don la gsum/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad/ don bsdu ba'o// dang po la gnyis/ mdor bstan dngos dang dbang po'i rim pas khrid tshul lo// dang po ni/ ༈ / (7)so sor sdud dang bsam gtan dang*// srog rtsol de bzhin 'dzin pa dang*// rjes su dran dang ting nge 'dzin// rnal 'byor yan lag drug tu ni// rgyud du sangs rgyas mchog gis gsungs// kun la drug tu shes bya ste// gnyis pa ni/ ༈ /rab kyis dang po rtog pa'o// 'bring gis srog rtsol la sogs yin// tha mas drug po rim pas bsgom/ gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la bzhi/ nyams su len pa'i rten gyi gang zag /de nyams su blang ba'i lam/ lam des 'bras bu grub tshul/ zhar byung gi man ngag gzhan bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ ༈ byis pa gzhug dang bum pa dang*// gsang ba ye shes sngon song bas// bzhi pa yi ni dbang byas te// dam tshig rtsa ba yan lag can// de yis dben par gnas byas la/ ༈ / gnyis pa la gsum/ sku rdo rje sor bsam gyi yan lag /gsung rdo rje srog 'dzin gyi yan lag /thugs rdo rje rjes ting gi yan lag go /dang po la gnyis/ rgyas par bshad pa dang*/ don bsdu ba'o// dang po la gnyis/ so sor sdud pa'i yan lag dang*/ bsam gtan gyi yan lag go /dang po ni/ ༈ /so sor sdud pa 'di ltar bsgom// bsgom pa stong nyid bsgoms pa yis// 'gag pa rlung ni 'gag par byed// skye ba shugs la bde ba skye// 'byung ba lam rtags dngos su 'byung*// ngo bo stong pa nyid yin te// so so'i rtog pa thams cad sdud// dbye ba bcu ru gsungs pa yin// dbang po'i mngon sum dag tu bzhed// ye shes phung po shes rab bo// 'bol ba'i stan la byed pa ni// lus bsrang rdo rje skyil krung bca'// lce bzlog gsus sbyar mig gyen bzlog

/gtsug tor sgyur ba'i lta stangs so// lag gnyis rdo rje bsdam par bya// des ni rlung rnams 'ching byed pa'o// dpral ba'i thig ler srog bcug la// g.yas pa sa yi rlung dus bsgom// mtshan mo bla gab bcas pa ru// nam mkha' la dmigs stong nyid bsgom// srod dang tho rangs gung la min// nyin mo bla gab med pa ste// (8)nam mkha' la bltas snga dro phyi// nyi zer nyi ma'i gung la min// de ltar bsgoms pas yul sogs dgag /nang du lha yi mig sogs te// stong nyid gzugs te dmigs bcas mthong*// chos la pha rol bcu gnas la// lha la lha mo bcu zhes bya// rtags su lam la bcu mthong 'gyur// du ba smig rgyu mkha' snang dang*// mar me 'byung ste 'byung rlung thim// tha ma sprin med nam mkha' ni// rtags can shes rab pha rol phyin// 'bar ba zla nyi glog sgra gcan// thig le drug ste tha ma yin// thams cad rgyur mthong rtags can te// 'byung lnga ye shes phung po lnga// gsang 'dus mtshan brjod nas phyed phyed// sprul sku longs sku rtogs med do// rdo rje bslang ba'i bde ba 'byung*// bsgoms pas dus dkar ri mo nag /mthong ba nang du stong gzugs so// des ni stong gzugs rtogs par byed// so sor sdud la snyoms zhugs nas// sngags kun byin gyis rlob byed la// ngag gi bden par 'grub pa'o// gzung ba'i yul dang bral bar 'gyur// gnyis pa ni/ ༈ /gnyis pa bsam gtan yan lag ni// stong gzugs brtan phyir byed pa'o// ngo bo yul ni stong gzugs te// dus ni nam mkha' rgyu dus so// dbye ba rnam pa lnga zhes bya// lta stangs de nyid phyag rgya ni// mnyam gzhag yid kyi mngon sum ste// sgom pa sngar gyi stongs gzugs la// sems bzhag nam mkhar lta ba yin// 'byung ba'i rim pas gong thim pas// sa sogs gang mthong sgyu ma ltar// mnyam gzhag rjes thob med par mthong*// bsam gtan chags pa'i bde ba 'byung*// lha mos bskul la lung bstan thob// stong nyid sems 'jug shes rab ste// dngos rnams sems 'dzin rtog pa'o// de 'dzin 'jug pa spyod pa'o// sems kun gzhag pa dga' ba'o// bde ba phun sum mi g.yo bde// mkha' yi bdag nyid rnam (9)shes so// bsam gtan la ni snyoms zhugs na// mngon par shes pa thob par 'gyur//

gnyis pa don bsdu ba ni/ ༈ /de gnyis thog mar dge ba ste// stong gzugs rtogs pas bsnyen par gsungs// gnyis pa srog 'dzin gyi yan lag la gnyis/ rgyas par bshad pa dang*/ don bsdu ba'o// dang po la gnyis/ srog rtsol gyi yan lag dang*/ 'dzin pa'i yan lag go dang po ni/ ༈ /de nas stong gzugs mthong nas ni// mi 'gyur bde ba skye ba'i phyir// srog rtsol yan lag bsgom par bya// rkang pa gcig gis gcig mnan cing*// mthe bong nang bcug khu tshur bsdam// yul ni rtsa gsum rlung yin no// 'du byed phung po'i rlung rgyu'i dus// lta stangs bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'o// phyi ru dang po rlung gtor nas// nang du myur dang rnam sdud dang*// rengs dang sngags sbyor brda' yis ni// bum pa can dang rdul mtha' yis// rlung gnyis dbus su rab bcug nas// rlung bcu rab tu zhi bar bya// rdo rje mi la srog zhugs pa'i// bde ba nges par skye bar 'gyur// zla ba drug tu brtson byas pas// zhag re rlung bcu 'gag 'gyur te// nyi khri chig stong drug brgya 'gag /de yis lte bar rlung gnyis 'dom// ye shes gtum mo 'bar ba yis// sangs rgyas lha mo bcu sad nas// khu ba bcas pa'i bde ba 'byung*// steng du 'og tu gnas gnyis 'dod// ma zos bkres med zos kyang 'ju// thur sel mi 'dzag bde ba 'dzag /sgyu 'phrul rdo rje gsus po che// lus yang la sogs mi rtog bde// yid kyi mngon sum zhes bya'o// srog dang rtsol bas nges par ni// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' gzigs// gnyis pa ni/ ༈ /rlung sems rab tu brtan bya'i phyir// 'dzin pa'i yan lag bsgom par bya// yul ni bde ba'i rlung nyid do// brtan par 'dzin pas 'dzin pa'o// tshor ba'i phung po dbu mar gnas// lta stangs la sogs de 'dra la// lag pa gnyis bsdam nam mkha'i dus// dhū tīr (10)rlung ni tshud tsam ni// lam du mi 'gyur thig ler gzhug

/lus sogs thig le bzhi po la// rim dang cig car rlung sems ni// nges par btsud nas mi g.yo bya// de la mi g.yo brtan gyur pas// thig ler chags pa'i bde ba skye// bud med kun la snyoms 'jug kyang*// thig le lhung bar mi 'gyur ro// lus ston bde skye lus brtan 'gyur// de yang yid kyis mngon sum mo// rtag tu 'dzin pa'i stobs kyis ni// rdo rje sems dpa' yang dag 'jug /'chi bdag la sogs kyis mi tshugs// 'gro dang 'ong ba zad byed cing*// nyon mongs la sogs zad par byed// stobs bcu la ni 'jug par 'gyur// tshe ring nad med khams cha snyoms//

gnyis pa don bsdu ba ni/ ༈ /de gnyis bar du dge ba ste// nye bar bsgrub pa zhes bshad la// drag shul spyod par gsungs pa'o/ ༈ / gsum pa rjes ting gi yan lag la gnyis/ rgyas par bshad pa dang*/ don bsdu ba'o// dang po la gnyis/ rjes dran gyi yan lag dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi yan lag go /dang po ni/ ༈ /de nas bde ba spel bya'i phyir// rjes su dran pa'i yan lag bya// yul ni bde ba nyid yin te// bde ba rgyud la dran pa'o// ye shes rlung rgyu'i dus su'o// lta stangs lha yi lta ba ste// 'du shes phung por mthe'u chung gzhug /dbye ba gsum ste bsgoms stobs dang*// lag pa bud med sbyor ba yis// 'khor nas dpral gnas byang sems dbab// rdo rje nor bur rab bzung ba// dngul chu'i dpe yis shes byas la// steng nas 'og tu rdo rje gcig /de 'drar rlung sems gtad pas ni// dga' ba bzhi la bcu drug skyed// yar ngo chags chen mtshan nyid do// ras bal stag la bem shing dpe// spros bcas spros med shin tu med// 'pho ba'i bag chags spangs byas pas// sgrib pa gsum po dag par 'gyur// chags pa shin tu sbyang bar bya// de don bsgoms pas bde chen ni// lhan cig skyes pa skye bar 'gyur// mngon shes drug kyang (11)cher 'gyur zhing*// gzugs sku rnam gnyis mngon sum mthong*// nges par lung bstan thob par 'gyur// rang rig mngon sum du ni 'dod// rjes dran la ni snyoms 'jug pa// 'od kyi dkyil 'khor 'byung bar 'gyur// gzhan yang ye shes sku las so// bsgrub pa zhes ni gsungs pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ de nas mi 'gyur bde bsgrub phyir// ting nge 'dzin ni nges par bsgom// ngo bo bde stong gnyis med de// de la rtse gcig gnas pa'o// gzugs kyi dbyings kyi phung po sogs// ye shes rlung rgyu'i dus su'o// sangs rgyas zhi ba'i lta stangs te// lag pa ting 'dzin phyag rgya'o// bsgom pa dmigs bcas stong gzugs dang*// dmigs med bde ba ro mnyam la// sems ni mi g.yo brtan par gnas// dngos po thams cad bde 'char ro// dpal ldan mi 'gyur bde ba skye// sangs rgyas dngos su yang dag mthong*// de la brtan par gyur pa des// thig le gyen bzlog spyi bor 'gro// rdo rje nor bu ngo bo nyid// thob nas chos sku longs sku dang*// sprul sku gnas bzhir thob par 'gyur// rdo rje bzhi dang rnam thar dang*// byang chub bzhi yang rtogs par 'gyur// gsang gnas spyi bor rlung dag ni// stong dang brgyad brgya 'gags pa yis// sa ni bcu gnyis rim pas thob// sku ni bcu drug dag par 'gyur// thig le spyi bo rdul nor bu// mi gnas mya ngan 'das par brjod// yon tan thams cad rdzogs par 'gyur// ting 'dzin dbang bsgyur tsam gyis ni// sgrib pa thams cad bral bar 'gyur// dri ma med par dag par 'gyur// gzugs kyi phung por gsungs pa'o//

gnyis pa don bsdu ba ni/ ༈ sgrub pa chen po zhes bshad de// rnal 'byor mngon sum yin par 'dod// de gnyis tha mar dge bar 'dod// gsum pa lam de 'grub tshul la (12) gnyis/ gnas skabs dang*/ mthar thug go /dang po ni/ ༈ de ltar yan lag drug po la// lo gsum zla phyed gsum gyis ni// sangs rgyas 'dra bar 'gyur ba ste// sa dang thob pa zhes kyang 'dod// khams drug sbyangs ba ye shes drug /rigs drug pha rol phyin drug 'dod// mngon shes drug dang rjes dran drug /rlung drug ye shes bla ma gsungs// lus gzir 'phags la phyag rgya gsal/ gnyis pa ni/ ༈ de nas spyod pa gsum byas pas// dag pa'i sku bzhi ye shes 'grub// stobs sogs yon tan kun rdzob pa// tshe 'dir nges par 'gyur ba'o/ ༈ / bzhi pa 'phros don la gnyis/ bar do sangs rgyas pa'i man ngag dang*/ chags can phyag rgya'i man ngag go /dang po ni/ ༈ bar do sangs rgyas man ngag 'di// 'og rlung steng gi bu gar gdon// sbyor drug man ngag yod pa dag /ma bsgom na yang skye bdun 'grub// so sor sdud pa'i rtags byung zhing*// gal te shi bar gyur pa na// de ni lam nges sa dang 'phrad// de nas dngos grub thob par 'gyur// gnyis pa ni/ ༈ chags can sbyor drug man ngag ni// dbab dang gzung dang bzlog pa dang*// gnas su bskyal la rtsa dmigs gdab// rlung bsre sbyor ba drug pos bya// so sor sdud pa'i spog pa ni// drag tu byed bcing 'tsham par bya// bsam gtan stong gzugs drag tu bsgom// btsan thabs skor bas rlung gzung ba// mgo bo mi na'i bar du bya// rlung sems drag tu thig ler gzung*// chags la las rgya mang la sbyar// bde chen ro mnyam dag tu bya// gsum pa sgrub pa la snying por gdams pas spyi'i mjug bsdu ba ni/ ༈ 'di min mchog ni mi 'grub ces// gsungs pas nges par 'di bsgrub bya// rtog bsgom 'jig rten 'khor gsungs pas// bskyed rim la sogs ci zhig bya// dus 'khor zhabs kyis gsungs pa yin//

gsum pa mjug gi don ni/ ༈ sbyor ba yan lag drug gi man ngag dus 'khor zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i snyan brgyud zhal gyi man ngag rdzogs so// paṇḍi ta se ma nā tha dang*/ lo tsā ba 'bro shes rab grags kyis bsgyur ba'o// dus zhabs snyan rgyud (13) ces yongs su grags pa 'di ni// sbyor drug ring brgyud kyi man ngag gi rtsa ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'i gdams pa khyad par can te/ zhib par rnam bshad dang khrid yig rnams las rgya cher shes par bya'o/ ༈ /dus 'khor nye brgyud kyi man ngag /dpal sha ba ri'i sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i gzhung chung 'di 'chad pa la bzhi/ mtshan gyi don/ 'gyur gyi phyag /gzhung gi don/ mjug gi don to// dang po ni/ rgya gar skad du/ yo ga ṣo ḍaṅga nā ma/ bod skad du/ rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa zhes bya ba/ gnyis pa ni/ dpal rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo// gsum pa la gnyis/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ ༈ so sor gcod dang bsam gtan dang*// srog rtsol de bzhin 'dzin pa dang*// rjes su dran pa ting nge 'dzin// rnal 'byor yan lag drug tu gsungs// gnyis pa la drug las/ dang po so sor gcod pa'i yan lag ni/ ༈ mi g.yo ba ni gsum ldan gyis// dhū tīr rlung bcu chud gyur pa// phyi nang rtog 'gags rtags byung ba// so sor gcod pa'i yan lag yin// gnyis pa bsam gtan gyi yan lag ༈ rtags rnams brtan par mthong 'gyur pa// shes rab rtog dpyod dga' bde dang*// rtse gcig mi g.yo rtog med ni// bsam gtan gyi ni yan lag yin// gsum pa srog rtsol gyi yan lag ༈ rlung bcu dbu mar tshud gyur pas// 'khor lo bzhi yi thig le'i nang*// rlung nyid 'gro 'ong byed pa ni// srog rtsol gyi ni yan lag yin/ bzhi pa 'dzin pa'i yan lag ༈ srog rlung thig le'i nang chud pas// rlung sems bde chen 'khor lo yi// haṃ gi thig le zin pa ni// 'dzin pa yi ni yan lag yin/

lnga pa rjes dran gyi yan lag ༈ rlung sems thig ler zin stobs kyis// gtum mo'i me 'od snang ba dang*// bde drod khyad par can 'byung ba// rjes su dran pa'i yan lag yin// drug pa ting 'dzin yan lag ༈ rtags bcu rdzogs par gyur pa na// thig le chen po'i snang ba 'byung*// sna tshogs (14)thig le chen po la// re khā nag po'i ri mo 'byung*// de nas 'gro drug la sogs dang*// shin tu phra ba'i sprul sku dang*// longs sku du ma mthong gyur pa// sna tshogs gzugs brnyan 'od gsal yin// de la sems ni thim pa na// ting 'dzin yan lag mthar phyin pa'o// bzhi pa mjug gi don ni/ rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa zhes bya ba/ dpal sha ba ri dbang phyug gis paṇḍi ta ma hā bi bhū hi tsand+ra la gsungs pa'o// des sgra rang 'gyur du bsgyur nas gsungs pa'o// 'di ni sha ba ri'i lugs kyi sbyor drug nye brgyud kyi gzhung khyad par can no// maṅga laṃ// ༈ /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gces btus spar ldeb ri bo'i grangs ldan 'di// bla ma'i mdun dge rtsa 'brel 'jog zhu ba po/ lhu mtsho/ lha mtsho a phrug gsum nas so// shu bhaṃ//
